maddeler.e:
نتشاجر (form VI)
# نَتَشَاجَرُ (natašājaru) /na.ta.ʃaː.d͡ʒa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَاجَرَ (tašājara)
# نَتَشَاجَرَ (natašājara) /na.ta.ʃaː.d͡ʒa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاجَرَ (tašājara)
# نَتَشَاجَرْ (natašājar) /na.ta.ʃaː.d͡ʒar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَاجَرَ (tašājara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
